title: Mit hozott a kiegyezés Magyarországnak? (What the Compromise Changed)
grammar: Concessive Connectors, Purpose Clauses & Dual Constitutional Register

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can say what changed in Hungary's economy and cities after 1867.
I can use lehetővé tette and ugyanakkor to describe a result and its limits.
I can say that historians still debate the Compromise when asked for an assessment.
I can read a short text about the economic boom and answer questions about it.
